invariants.rationale: The method directly calls Texture.setFilter(min, mag); effects, and null TextureFilter values may not be acceptable for graphics filter settings.
The method directly calls Texture.setFilter(min, mag); effects, and null TextureFilter values may not be acceptable for graphics filter settings.
Filtering modes for minification and magnification are often intentionally different for best results; this invariant checks for their difference.
Filtering enums may have a natural ordering, where minification is expected to be less than or equal to magnification in effect strength.
min must be one of the valid Texture.TextureFilter enum values.
